newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Philippine interbank call loan market was closed on Friday for a holiday marking All Saints Day when Filipinos visit family graves to honour their dead.
The market will reopen on Monday. On Thursday, the overnight money rate was unchanged at 11.0625 percent in a lacklustre session.
Traders said business volume was low as most banks stayed away, wanting to stay liquid before the long weekend.
